name: zealot-mtproto-worker
description: One-shot batch script wrapping GramJS to archive our own release artifacts via Telegram MTProto cold storage (task #6). Run by .github/workflows/mtproto_archive.yml on a schedule, against the Zealot Rails app's token-authed Api::MtprotoArchiveController (task #19f) -- never exposed publicly, never runs as a server.
